name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: If Potter does not go with Millpond, then all of Tanner goes with Wulfric, Tanner goes with Eastcheap, and no one in the Joiners' Guild goes with Matilda.
Exactly two of these are true: Beatrix goes with Potter; Edmund goes with Highrow; Blacksmith goes with Riverside.
Either Eastcheap goes with Edmund or someone in the Market Ward goes with Beatrix.
Mason, Tanner, and Millpond go with Cedric, Edmund, and Wulfric, in some order.
Between Beatrix and Cedric, one goes with Potter and the other with Millpond.

So Matilda does not go with Mason.
